facts.project_name: SAP CLOUD ALM Technical Monitoring Change Request Management

facts.scope_summary: Implementation of SAP Cloud ALM for Technical Monitoring and Change Request Management aligned with the S/4 RISE migration plan. Scope includes Cloud ALM tenant setup, standard change management, monitoring and alerting use cases, dashboards, and transition to the METRO team.

SAP Landscape management, Data flow configuration to CALM

Dev + QA ChaRM Configuration E2E Test Cycle
Tech Monitoring Config for Non-Prod systems + Alert and Notifications
assumptions: Identification of customer landscape: SAP S/4HANA Cloud, BTP apps, MII
Train the Trainer workshop plan & readiness
Key roles personas mapping for authorization testing
Successful go live of all the landscapes
